recovery.query: SELECT id FROM runs WHERE status = 'active' AND phase NOT IN ('DONE', 'FAILED_BLOCKED', 'FAILED') AND finished_at IS NULL ORDER BY started_at ASC
recovery.scoping: QUERIES ALL ACTIVE INCOMPLETE RUNS — no per-run filter beyond status/phase/finished_at
recovery.cross_run_risk: If Run B is still 'active' at recovery time, it WILL be picked up as incomplete alongside Run A — potential cross-contamination

worker.claim_mechanism: BullMQ job claiming — atomic by design
worker.note: Redis ECONNREFUSED on local dev => queue inactive, runs execute synchronously

persistence.foreign_keys: run_events.run_id, artifacts.run_id, run_signals.run_id all reference runs.id
persistence.wal_mode: WAL (Write-Ahead Logging) — PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE) required after external writes

state_isolation.run_id_propagation: Every DB write scoped by run_id
global_state_risks: recoverIncompleteRunsOnStartup() iterates ALL active incomplete runs (fire-and-forget)
Checkpoint writes: scoped by run_id in DB

locking.db_level: No explicit DB-level row locking found

concurrency_settings.max_fix_loops: POSITRON_MAX_FIX_LOOPS (env var, default from MAX_FIX_LOOPS constant)
concurrency_settings.parallel_run_risk: 2 concurrent workers + recovery iterates all active runs = potential for 2+ simultaneous pipeline executions
